Prepare track, cell and IZ tables for heterogeneity analysis

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity.R
prepare_iz_data.Rd

Collect the IZ-assigned tracks (one row per cell and IZ; duplicated cell-IZ assignments are merged: outer start/end, width-weighted centre, maximum flag), the IZ metadata and the cell replication progress, and derive per-track features relative to the IZ centre (q50): relative initiation position, left/right/total track length and fork asymmetry.

Usage

prepare_iz_data(
  tracks,
  gr_izones,
  cell_metadata = NULL,
  progress_col = "rep_percent"
)

Arguments

tracks

Named GRangesList of tracks (every cell with at least one track) with columns cell_id, rep_percent, iz_id and flag (e.g. define_initiation_zones()$tracks).

gr_izones

GRanges of IZs with iz_id, q5-q95, n_tracks and optionally the firing range (e.g. calculate_firing_range()).

cell_metadata

NULL or a data.frame with cell_id and progress_col; if it has NAs, the track rep_percent is used.

progress_col

Progress column of cell_metadata.

Value

A list with track_intervals, cell_metadata (with replication_progress), iz_metadata and diagnostics.
